messages:
anya: FYI customers on the canary are seeing inconsistent sampling rates in console. suspect client+infra both toggling sampling.

juan: can you repro and paste headers?

anya: repro: py-sdk canary sets X-RWD-SAMPLER:1, proxy adds X-RWD-SAMPLED:true when it decides to sample. server emits both which inflates console counts.

mike: short term: server ingestion should prefer client header when present. long term: propose a lightweight handshake: client advertises SAMPLE_HANDSHAKE:preferred and proxy defers if it sees that.

repo-bot: opened ticket infra#442 (handshake proposal)

eva: SDKs can add opt-in env RDWD_SAMPLE_MODE=client-first. i'll draft small py/ts patches behind flags. also need a console flag to show "deduped vs raw" counts.

anya: owners: mike(ingest), eva(sdks), juan(proxy). recon after patch deploy to confirm console numbers.
